50/- Printed at Labanya Press, Guwahati-1 --- Page 5 --- Katta Bichongrang Jak Aganchengani. Fridina Koknal Marak.
Sisobrao Jumang 12 Angni School 2. 36 Ma-giparang aro A.songni Mikkangchi Ong.bagni Salrang ...
National Film Award : 1993 45 5.

Salgro Salaram A-dok 48 --- Page 6 --- AGANCHENGANI "Sisobrao Jumang" ine chinga ia ki-tap bi-sani bimingko donna namnikaha. Sisobrao Jumangara ia kitapo man-chapatgipa seanirangoni mingsa ong.oba, ianon Ma Fridina Koknal Marakni gisikni re-ani, jatna a-songna ka-saani, A.chikni dakbewal-rikbewalko ripingna skani, seani ritingantion, sentence ge-antion jojranga.

Uni gimin chinga iakon katta bichongna kranikbea. Adita bilsirangna skang, Shillongo kam ka-gipa A.chik me.chik Officerrang Dol ge-sako bikote, una Noringro Nojingjo Organisation (N.N.O.) ine biming on-aha.
Noringro Nojingjo- ni ortoara "Aski Tom-daksa". Ia Dolni skanggipa Presidentara Ma Fridina Koknal Marak.
Gipin member-rangara Ma Hero- ine Bangshall Sangma, Ma Debilla Bolwary Marak, Ma Anita Lizana K.
Sangma, Ma Verna K. Sangma, Ma Kamala Raksam Marak, Ma Bharati B.

Sangma, Ma Withmollish Mangsang Sangma, Ma Isabella D. Marak, Ma Hannah Lee Kin Kaid Cheran Momin, Ma Hemalata Chambugong Marak, Ma Mirnaloy Dajel Marak, Ma Jahanara Koksi Sangma, Ma Keziah Me.cheng Sangma, Dr.

Kumie Raksam Marak aro Ma Brucellish Koksi Sangma. Dolni manderang an-tangtang bang-a bang.ja on-grime, A-chikska-rangoniko gile aro Gauhatini Assam Academy For Cultural Relations-ni, Pa Harendra Wa-ge Marakni tom-chimonggimin Ku-bidikko chapa ka-atgipako bree lapna palskae adita tangkarangko chimongaha.
Uchin Dolni nang- chongmotgipa bosturangko brechenge, A.chikkuo segimin ki-taprangko aro A.chikrangni rokomari jako gitoko gananirangko aro rangrangko bree chimongaha.
Adita susaanirangko A.chik bi.sarangnaba dakate boksisrangko on-aha. Indiba brikalgipa memberrang kamoni nengtake re-bildangtokahaon, ia Dol be-gruange, ja-mano dongsrangjaha.

--- Page 7 --- Adita bilsirangni ja-mano Turao donggipa member gitchamrang, N.N.O.-ni bosturangko pale aro Banko donggipa tangkako oksrange, bribatgipa member sakgittamni sea- nirangko ki-tap chapa ka-atskana tom-e chanchiaha. Ia somoeo Ma Kamala Marakba DIET-ni Principal ong-e Turaona re-baaha; indake bini dakchakaniko bang-en man-aha.
Ma Fridina aro Ma Heroine re-rorona bil dongjahani gimin, Dr. Kumie aro Ma Brucellish baditaba chang re-anga re-baa dake, ku.pattianiko ra-rurae, agangrikanirangko matchotataha.
Indake Ma Fridina, Ma Heroine aro Ma Vernani seanirangko ki-tap dakna tik ka-manchaaha.

Shillongchi re-angarango gipin memberrangko gronge, gronggi- jarangminga phonechi agangrike aro grongsranggi- jagiparangba ia tik ka-aniko ra-chakpaaigen ine ka-donge, ki-tap dakna chanchianiko kamo chu-sokatna ja-ku gaaiaha. Ian 2oo9-ni a-bachengachibara.

Kumie aro Ma Brucellish, Ma Fridinako grongna re-angon, ua an-tangan basee uni seanirangko chingna on-ataha. Badiabarangde sechenggipako tong.kandi setaienggiparangsa, mitama on-jotani aro namatpilani donggiparangsa ong-ani gimin, seanirangko tik bimango dontaina nangahae, ki-tapko nakatatningna man.jaha.
Chingni uko grongtaina re-angon, Ma Fridina skanggipa bilonge saaoni nambapilenga. Ua an-sengsrangahaon, gipin seanirangko basee mingsa minggni on.dapkugen ine aganachim.
Neng-taksrange ja-mano basena man-aigen ine chingni aganon, ua bakan an-sengpilaigen aro basee on.dapatna man-aigen ine aganchaka.
Indiba ia chol chingona sokbana skangan uko Nokgipa Isol neng-takkamsrangkan rimangaha. Ma Fridina ia ki-tapko nikna baditan kusi ong-begenchim.

Garo Graduates' Unionni 2oo9-ni “Mikaoa" magazineo, Ma Brucellish Ma Fridinani photoko on-chape uni gimin sea. Uko kingsa bina ra-ange on-on, ua kusi ong-bee, angni ki-tapo --- Page 8 --- iakoba man-chapatbone ine ua an-tangan aganani gimin, ua seanikoba iano man-chapata.

N.N.O.-ni minggipin chanchichotaniara ianchim : "Ki-tapko N.N.O.-ni koroschi chapa ka-atgen, indiba A.chik Literature Society pale ra.china ki-taprangko on-an baksanaba, Copyright-koba ia Society-nan on·gen. Ki-tap pala bon·o chapa ka-attaina am-oba maming badi dongjawa".
N.N.O.-ni chimonggipa A.chikku magazinerang aro ki-taprangko A.chik Literature Society-na on-manaha.

Ia ki-tapko brean baksa, palanio dakchakpaode chinga kusi ong·begen, maina A-chik Literature Society A-chikkuo sca- jotaninasan kam ka-aigija, A.chik jatni namgnina, A.chikni dakbewal rikbewalrangko ripingna on-kange kam ka-enggipa Dol ong-a. Mittelbea.
Kumie R. Marak Ma Brucellish K.
Sangma (N.N.O. Memberrangni palo) --- Page 9 --- FRIDINA K.
MARAK ano on-gipa photoara 1975 bilsio ka-gipa, Fridina Koknal LMarakni photo.
A.chik me.chikrangoni nikseng- batgiparangoni saksa, Fridina 1928 bilsini April jani 13 tariko Turao atchiaha. Pagipara SingdonKoksi Sangma aro ma-gipara Panse Koknal Marak.
Singdon Koksi Babelaparao L.P. Schoolo skia.
Kamoni 1938 bilsio neng-take ua Lucy Smith Book Roomo jao Rs. 2o/-na Superintendent ka-a.
Apsan somoeon double- storeyed Boys' Hostel ge-gnioni ge-sani Superintendent ong.e, jao Rs.
2o/-ko man-a. Segipani siani ja-manosa, Panse Koknal Chandmaryo cha dokan kulia.
Singdon Koksi aro Panse Koknalni dedrang sakbri : demechik dejakra Elina; gnigipara Fridina. Unikode depante Benard aro deokgite Sandford.
Elinako kni ro.e chambile nitoana mitteltokbea. Una bakrogipajanggi tanganiko sesojae, ua 1948 bilsion siaiaha.
Benard Koknal Veterinary Departmento Joint Director ong-achim; uaba siangsoaha.
Jongchon Sandford Koknal Political Scienceo aro Economicso M.A. pass ka-a.
Ua Education, P.H.E., Health aro uagita mongsonggipa portfoliorangko Cabinet Minister ong.e nirokachim. Uaba siangsoaha.
Fridina American Baptist Mission Schoolo poraichenge, Tura Government High Schooloba poraia. Ua Lucknowni King George's Medical Collegeo 1947 oni 1953 ona poraie Nursing Graduate ong-a.
Ua skangni Agra and Oudh Provinceoniko scholarship man-achim ine agana.
Ja·mano ua Gauhati --- Page 10 --- Universityni ning-o Matriculation Examinationko pass ka-a. Ua ia apsan Universityni ning.on Intermediate Artsko pass ka-a aro Bachelor of Arts degreekoba man-a.
Ua Indian Institute of Mass Communication, South Extension, New Delhio poraia. Dambemitingo uni namnikgipa kal-aniranga badminton aro basketball.
Ua Lucknow Women's Basket Ball Teamni memberba ong-achimna. Poraia matchote Fridina Lucknowni Lady Dufferine Hospitalo Nursing Sister ong.e kam ka-aha.
Unomitingo Garo Hills gugrakugijagipa Assamni bak ong- engani gimin, Fridina Tura Kalazaar Hospitaloba kam ka-aha.
Ua Nursing Sister ong-e gimik gimang bilsi 11 kam ka-aha. Lucknow-o nursing courseko poraina uko bon-kamgipa bigil gipok, gugrakugijagipa Assamni Governor Sir Andrew aro Mrs.
Clow dakchakaha. Bano poraina ska ine biapko basena on-oa, "luck"-ara rasong aro “"now"-ara da.on, da-on rasong namenga ine chanchie ua Lucknowko seokaha ine agana.
Tura Government Multipurpose Schoolo Garo skigipa dongja. A.chik bi-sarangde bon-gramaignok ine, Turani ma-a paarang Fridinako sana bananikamko wate Garo skichina molmolaha.
Indakesa ua Nursing kamoni chel-e re.baaha aro Assam Education Serviceni ning-0 1960 oni 1965 ona skigipani kamko jako ra-aha.

1965 oni 1977 bilsionade Fridina Government of Indiani Information and Broadcasting Ministryo, Central Information Serviceni ning.o Field Publicity Officer ong-achim. 1985 bilsio ua Meghalaya Bank Recruiting Boardni member ong-achim.

Ua 1989 oni 1991 ona Meghalaya Handloom and Handicrafts Development Corporationni Chairmanba ong-achim. Fridina 1978 oni 1984 ona Meghalaya Public Service Commissionni member ong-e jattangna a-songtangna kam ka-aha.

Fridina Koknal badia Dolna ba Association-na kam ka-jaha ine sandinan altubatsusu nikpila. Segipa-jotgiparangni, ring.gipa dokgipa dam-giparangni, me-chikrangni, chadamberangni, chatro-chatrirangni, jatni namgnina ka-giparangni aro gipin gipin dolrangna uni dilani aro kamo on-gilani ma-kaa.
Fridina Garo Hills District Socio-Cultural
